summary: All 50 source files passed integrity checks, and all eight proposed computations reproduced. The `no_valid_comparison` closure failed. Using only intermediate time points, I independently recovered all 179 gene identities in Figure 13A. Of 170 genes present in the registered output, 156 had a readable week-12 versus day-0 direction. Among those, 147 agreed with the registered direction and nine were opposite. [Oku et al., Figure 13](https://doi.org/10.1587/nolta.17.186)
openIssues: The comparison covers a selected heatmap panel. Fourteen paired directions remain indeterminate at the figure’s color resolution, and nine plotted genes lack a registered DE row.
Gene-level author endpoint P values and FDR remain unavailable. The published figure supports directional comparison only.
The manual review still needs a publisher full-text access record and paper link.
